data.gender_notes: Reyansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Reyansh is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Riyan' meaning 'Intelligent' and 'Ish' meaning 'King' or 'Lord'. This name signifies a wise and powerful leader. It is a popular name in Hindu tradition, especially among followers of Vaishnavism. The name Reyansh carries the meaning “Intelligent, King, Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Reyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, king, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
